title: Rabbi Chanilai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Niddah 43b, speaking in the name of Rabbi Elazar bar Shimon. In Yevamot 62b: “Rabbi Tanchum said that Rabbi Chanilai said: Any Jew who has no wife lives without joy, without blessing.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Niddah 43b fully writes Rav Chanilai reporting Rabbi Elazar beRabbi Shimon, supporting Elazar for ר״א. Yevamot 62b has Rabbi Chanilai and כל אדם, “any person,” whereas Hyman supplies “any Jew.” The differing full title forms and Hyman’s narrower wording remain explicit.

The checked Niddah 43b fully writes Rav Chanilai reporting Rabbi Elazar beRabbi Shimon; Yevamot 62b fully writes Rabbi Chanilai and says “any person.” Hyman’s “any Jew” and his source-specific abbreviated title are preserved. The two fully written title forms are not automatically harmonized.
